notes: A steel tube frame carrying a one-piece molded resin basket. The figures are from the June 2024 North American sheet (form 1787).

gaps: The sheet names only rear fixed casters and a rear roller lifter; caster size, count and bearing type are not given, so none are claimed.
Tube wall thickness and steel grade are not given beyond 'heavy-gauge oval tube'.
The text layer of page 3 reads 18,130 in3 total payload in one place; the rendered table shows 18,120 in3 (297 L), which is used.
The sheet is dated June 2024; no production years are given.
method: Wanzl Hybrid HC20 product sheet (PDF, form 1787, June 2024): read as text; the specs table on page 3 read from a rendered image.

comps.spec: Heavy-gauge oval steel tube frame in Granite TECH-SEAL finish (three-year written warranty against spreading corrosion); one-piece molded resin basket attached without rivets. Total payload 18,120 cu in (297 L), top basket 11,120 cu in (182 L), nesting 10.5 in, weight 53.5 lb (24.3 kg).
Rear fixed casters, which a rear roller lifter raises when carts are nested.

sources.title: Wanzl Hybrid HC20 shopping cart product sheet, form 1787 (June 2024), North America
